comment: Placement constraints for bw_layout_tool (copy next to your cave_layout.json and run the tool there). Room space, metres, origin = floor centre, +Y up (the floor is y=0; the observer's ears are ~1.4 m up). 'bounds' = the allowed box (speakers must be inside). 'nogo' = boxes speakers must stay OUT of (screens, structure, the CAVE interior). 'obstacles' = SOLID occluders (projectors, beams): a speaker can't be inside one NOR in its acoustic shadow — a box on the line from the speaker to the ears blocks its sound. 'label' is ignored by the loader.

nogo.label: CAVE interior 4x4x4 cube (observer + screens; speakers go BEHIND the screens)

obstacles.label: ceiling projector (throws down the floor screen)
